search_window.basis: Previous read-back-verified Food Line heartbeat completion through current observation; first Sunday in November clocks reverted from PDT (UTC-07) to PST (UTC-08), so this interval crosses the DST fallback and is approximately two real hours. Results screened against incident and original-publication/announcement times, not merely search-index recency.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary recall; national production collector remains authoritative.
classes_checked: Loss, closure, fire or disaster affecting the sole, last, only or full-service grocery store in a community
Emergency food distributions canceled or suspended because of storm, flood, fire, outage or facility damage
Abrupt pantry or food-bank closure or major access reduction
New official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate food-access consequences
bounded_query_context: "November 1 2026" food bank distribution canceled storm outage
"Nov 1 2026" grocery store fire only store town
"November 1, 2026" food bank closure suspended food assistance
coverage_notes.observation: All 12 bounded searches yielded usable results. No independently verified new qualifying disruption was identified within this run's observation window. Search hits were dominated by duplicates, previously announced benefits purchasing restrictions, older events, routine food assistance listings, donation drives, and new grocery/pantry openings.

coverage_notes.limitations: Local notices may appear in search indices after the run; no negative guarantee for unindexed or late-posted provider/agency notices. DST fall-back made this actual-time observation window longer than a nominal hour.
coverage_notes.production_authority: Production collection authoritative; no content approval, publishing, schedule changes or task disabling.
